item.title: Bloodywood Announce “System of a Brown” 2026 North American Tour

item.title: King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard AI Clone Discovered on Spotify
item.description: The Aussie psych rockers removed their catalog in July to protest CEO Daniel Ek's investment in an AI military tech company. King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard AI Clone Discovered on Spotify Eddie Fu
